verdict.rationale: Maritime's own platform puts agents to sleep automatically when idle and wakes them on demand. Its docs cite built-in sleep/wake via the three-endpoint contract, sleep-when-idle for web apps, "sleep/wake economics", and always-on as a paid add-on, which implies idle sleep is the default. However, nothing shows a developer can set or tune the timeout. Billing is flat per agent with no meters, so sleeping does not reduce the bill in a per-runtime sense. Missing for 10: developer-configurable idle/max-lifetime timeout settings (SDK/CLI/API parameters), explicit shutdown-when-done behavior, documentation of idle thresholds, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
